SideSpeed 0.5.3 fixes faster animations on Fire TV and tidies the Apps screen.

## Fixes
- **Fire TV: Settings works with faster animations.** On Fire TV, changing the app animation speed stopped the home screen's Settings menu from opening. SideSpeed now leaves that one speed alone on Fire TV and speeds up window and transition animations only. If 0.5.2 already changed it on your Fire TV, open **Tools → Faster animations** and press **Restore original**, then choose **Faster** again.
- **Simpler Apps screen.** The **Type a package** tab is gone; **Sideloaded** and **All apps** cover it. The whole top row, including **Mode**, now fits on screen without scrolling.

**Updating:** press **Update now** on the update notice, or **About → Check for updates**. From 0.4.0 or earlier, update once with Downloader (code **3503400**) or `sidespeed.app/tv`.

Updating stops the helper, as before. On Google TV, open SideSpeed to start it again; on Fire TV, the Companion starts it.

The Companion apps have no changes in this release.

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.5.3.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.3.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.3-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.3-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.3-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
